name: Butt Kicks

instructions.description: Stand tall with your feet about hip-width apart and your arms relaxed at your sides. Keep your chest lifted and brace your core lightly.
Start jogging softly in place on the balls of your feet. Bend one knee to bring your heel toward the same-side glute.

Lower your foot softly as the opposite heel lifts toward your glute. Continue alternating sides in a quick, even rhythm. Swing your arms naturally like you would during an easy run and gradually increase the speed to a comfortable pace.
Maintain an upright posture and a controlled rhythm for the target duration. Focus on soft, quiet landings and consistent movement.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the duration completed at an individually appropriate intensity.

commentsNotes: Keep your knees pointing mostly downward rather than driving them forward.
Do not force your heels to touch your glutes if this causes you to arch your back.
Use shorter intervals if your foot contacts become sloppy or your technique deteriorates.
